Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
Can a Grotesque be influenced out if you control no locations? I would suggest yes, but again IANPB.

Grotesque
Clan: Gargoyle (group 6)
Capacity: 3
Disciplines: for pot vis
Camarilla. Tremere slave: Non-unique. When played, choose a location you control not chosen for a Grotesque. Remove this Grotesque from the game if you no longer control the location. Flight [FLIGHT].

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418
